note: Featured real storms from the DONKI archive. Facts checked against src/data/storms.json (flare class, Kp) and NOAA/NASA reporting on the May 2024 storms.

slots.title: The biggest flare since 2010
slots.story: Class X9.3: the biggest solar flare in NASA's records since 2010. It shook Earth's magnetic field up to Kp 8 out of 9.
slots.story_ms: Kelas X9.3: nyalaan suria terbesar dalam rekod NASA sejak 2010. Ia menggegarkan medan magnet Bumi sehingga Kp 8 daripada 9.

slots.title: The May 2024 aurora storm
slots.story: One of the flares behind the May 2024 storms, the strongest to hit Earth in about 20 years. People saw auroras much closer to the equator than usual.
slots.story_ms: Salah satu nyalaan di sebalik ribut Mei 2024, ribut paling kuat melanda Bumi dalam kira-kira 20 tahun. Orang ramai nampak aurora jauh lebih dekat dengan khatulistiwa daripada biasa.

slots.title: The October 2024 giant
slots.story: Class X9.0: the second biggest flare in NASA's records since 2010. It reached Kp 7 at Earth.
slots.story_ms: Kelas X9.0: nyalaan kedua terbesar dalam rekod NASA sejak 2010. Ia mencapai Kp 7 di Bumi.
